newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT EASES VS DOLLAR, BCE LIRA MOST TRADED.
newsitem.headline: FORINT EASES VS DOLLAR, BCE LIRA MOST TRADED.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed the Thursday session of the interbank forex market weaker against the dollar after slow trading, dealers said.
The forint finished at 155.32/37 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 155.20/25.
"The forint traded close to the central bank's bid (resistance level) for most of the day and turnover remained low," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
On the Budapest Commodities Exchange (BCE), yen futures were the main movers, dropping for four maturities while the dollar also finished lower for three maturities.
The Ecu rose for three maturities, the sterling ended higher for two and the Italian lira finished mixed.
German mark futures ended mostly steady and the Swiss franc remained unchanged.
Italian lira contracts accounted for 24,370 of the total 40,395 contracts, representing 5.6 billion forints of turnover.
